import json, pathlib, subprocess
def run(argv):
    p=subprocess.run(argv,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False)
    return {'argv':argv,'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}
state=pathlib.Path.home()/'.local/state/hadalis-automation/chat-bridge.json'
out={
  'bridge':run(['systemctl','--user','show','hadalis-chat-bridge.service','--no-pager','--property=ActiveState','--property=SubState','--property=Result','--property=ExecMainCode','--property=ExecMainStatus','--property=ExecMainStartTimestamp','--property=ExecMainExitTimestamp']),
  'worker':run(['systemctl','--user','show','hadalis-worker.service','--no-pager','--property=ActiveState','--property=SubState','--property=Result']),
  'chatgpt':run(['systemctl','--user','show','hadalis-chatgpt.service','--no-pager','--property=ActiveState','--property=SubState','--property=Result']),
  'state_exists':state.exists(),
  'state_text':state.read_text() if state.exists() else None,
  'journal':run(['journalctl','--user','-u','hadalis-chat-bridge.service','-n','40','--no-pager','-o','short-iso'])
}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
